content:
Executive Suite Style Pack

Steffen | 2026-03-16 5 items. Corner office energy.

# Item ID Name Default Room
1 cr-award-shelf Voxel Award Display Shelf patrik, main-hall
2 cr-whiskey-decanter Voxel Whiskey Decanter Set patrik, alex
3 cr-globe Voxel Desk Globe alex, patrik, steve
4 cr-cigar-box Voxel Cigar Box patrik
5 cr-leather-chair Voxel Executive Leather Chair patrik, alex

Design Theme

This is the corner office. Dark wood, brass accents, crystal, leather. Premium without being gaudy. Every item says "decisions happen here." Patrik's room gets all 5 by default. Alex gets the globe, decanter, and chair (strategy needs gravitas). The award shelf goes in main-hall to show the team what they've earned.

Why This Pack Matters

When business owners sign up for Corner, the premium tier unlocks furniture packs like this. The Executive Suite says "your AI operations center looks like a real office, not a toy." It's the visual proof that this platform takes their business seriously.

Renders

All 5 items have transparent PNG renders at 128x128px (2x retina) and JSON sidecars with full metadata.
